title: Atolia v2 1000-year structural carrier prior
status: neutral structural prior for the direct-NetCDF v2 world; mass accounting lives in v2_config.py

claim.material: legacy copper-equivalent corridor intensity used only to shape structural production cells
claim.measure: relative structural carrier intensity; not the authoritative v2 primary-metal ledger
claim.interpretation: This 200,000 t value is retained only as a structural intensity normalization inherited from v1. The direct v2 builder separately conserves 1 Mt primary Cu world-total and targets 200 kt Atesis-associated primary Cu; these quantities must not be conflated with this corridor prior.

time_prior_note: The phase split is deliberately a broad structural prior. It is not a claim that 200 kt physically crossed Verona, nor that 200 kt were mined in the Atesis basin. v2 primary-metal accounting is external to this file.
geometry_note: Waypoints are only a stable skeleton for the legacy structural world. Step 4.5/Step 5 hydrological evidence, inferred palaeochannels and sampled hydro realization provide the actual v2 carrier surface.

evidence_anchors.label: Mitterberg scale comparator
evidence_anchors.role: external production-scale comparator; not assumed to feed the Atesis
evidence_anchors.source: Pernicka, Lutz & Stoellner, Bronze Age Copper Produced at Mitterberg and its Distribution

evidence_anchors.label: Eastern Trentino smelting field
evidence_anchors.role: production-field prior; exact v2 contribution remains latent
evidence_anchors.source: Bellintani et al., Prehistoric copper production in Trentino

evidence_anchors.label: Acqua Fredda / Redebus Pass
evidence_anchors.source: Deutsches Bergbau-Museum, Praehistorische Kupferproduktion in Trentino Orientale

evidence_anchors.label: Frattesina redistribution node
evidence_anchors.role: late trans-shipment / manufacturing comparator near the Po-Adriatic system
evidence_anchors.source: Pearce, Bellintani & Nicolis, Frattesina and the later Bronze Age–Early Iron Age metals trade

tests: Can geological source fields satisfy the independent v2 primary-metal ledger without impossible extraction?
Does the implied slag, charcoal, timber and labour footprint fit the simulated mining/metallurgical ecology?
Do geochemical mixtures require several source fields and repeated recycling?
Does neutral palaeohydrology create structured carrier alternatives rather than a forced Atesis route?
Can the generated world be distinguished from lower-throughput/null worlds after preservation and discovery bias?
